title: CC: RJ45
description: This mod adds new connection capabilities to your game.
body:
# CC:RJ45

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GZ875jdx/images/f0da672c800088c6927089e676554bca0a04641c.jpeg)


_NOW WITH SABLE COMPATS!!!_


This mod adds wired connectors and hubs for CC:Tweaked.

## Blocks & Items

**Net Cable Connector** (`net_cable_connector`) — connects to any solid surface. Up to 2 links per connector. Acts as a standard CC:Tweaked wired network endpoint.

**Net Cable Hub** (`net_cable_hub`) — same form factor, 4 links. Lets you build star topologies without chaining blocks.

**Huge Net Cable Connector** (`net_cable_connector_huge`) — a larger variant with thicker, darker cables. Supports up to 2 links with an extended range (default 38 blocks, configurable up to 512). Rotates toward the player when placed on the ground or ceiling, like stairs.

**Net Connector Cable** (`net_connector_cable`) — the linking item. Right-click two connectors to create a cable link. Sneak + right-click to break a link.

**Portable Drive** (`portable_drive`) — a portable hard drive for CC:Tweaked computers. Dyeable in 16 colours, works in any disk drive. Crafted with terracotta and amethyst.


![Thing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GZ875jdx/images/2ad00dceda5132b77bbb87c96d9049eb32f37018.jpeg)


## Cable Linking
- Links are distance-limited (default 15 blocks, configurable up to 256; Huge variant defaults to 38, configurable up to 512)
- Destroying a connector or hub automatically breaks its links
- Disconnect: empty hand + sneak + right-click two connected blocks
